structuredData.pageDescription: CARE AI is responsible, assistive healthcare AI built on CARE Core for medical scribing, voice workflows, form intelligence, clinical summaries, document AI, care planning, drug safety, and workflow support.
structuredData.appDescription: CARE AI is the responsible AI layer for CARE Core, supporting AI medical scribe workflows, voice EMR documentation, clinical summaries, document understanding, care planning, drug safety alerts, score calculators, and human-in-the-loop healthcare workflows.

context.title: Context
context.text: CARE Core supplies patient, role, facility, workflow, and record context.

draft.title: Draft
draft.text: AI listens, extracts, summarizes, suggests, calculates, or prepares a draft.

review.title: Review
review.text: The care team edits, approves, rejects, or asks for more evidence.

record.title: Record
record.text: Accepted output becomes auditable data inside CARE.

hero.title: Responsible AI on trusted healthcare infrastructure
hero.body: CARE AI brings AI-powered documentation, summarization, voice workflows, form intelligence, clinical context, care planning, safety alerts, and workflow support into the same open healthcare platform where care is delivered.

healthSystem.title: AI in healthcare should not sit outside the health system.
healthSystem.body: Most healthcare AI tools start with a model. CARE AI starts with the health system: patients, encounters, facilities, users, roles, forms, orders, labs, medications, referrals, care plans, tasks, audit trails, APIs, and standards-based data models.
thesis: It should understand the patient record.
It should follow permissions and audit trails.
It should help health workers, not replace them.

principle.title: AI drafts. Humans decide. CARE records. Systems learn.
principle.body: CARE AI is not a standalone chatbot, an AI doctor, or a black-box tool outside the clinical workflow. It is a set of AI skills powered by CARE Core and designed for accountable care teams.

grounded.title: Grounded in context
grounded.text: AI should use patient, encounter, facility, role, form, task, and workflow context from CARE Core.

reviewed.title: Reviewed before saving
reviewed.text: AI can listen, extract, summarize, suggest, calculate, and draft. The care team remains in control.

traceable.title: Traceable to sources
traceable.text: Summaries, handovers, care plans, and discharge drafts should point back to source information wherever possible.

roles.title: Governed by roles
roles.text: Doctors, nurses, field workers, administrators, volunteers, and researchers should not have the same AI permissions.

safety.title: Designed for safety
safety.text: AI should reduce burden without reducing accountability, and every capability should be evaluated in real care settings.

recorded.title: Recorded by CARE
recorded.text: Accepted AI output becomes part of the same auditable, standards-aligned health record where care is delivered.

core.title: Workflow-aware, patient-aware, and accountable.
core.body: A doctor opening an encounter needs different AI support from a nurse preparing a handover, a field worker completing a home visit, a registration staff member scanning documents, or a program manager improving a clinical form. CARE AI is designed for that reality.
context: Medications, allergies, vitals, labs, and observations
Care plans, tasks, referrals, and follow-ups

capabilities.title: From AI medical scribe to learning clinical workflows.
capabilities.body: CARE AI is a capability layer, not one feature. Each skill is meant to reduce burden, improve structured data capture, surface relevant patient context, and make healthcare workflows easier to complete.

careScribe.title: Care Scribe
careScribe.text: Voice-based documentation assistance grounded in the patient record and the active CARE workflow.
points: Audit of generated and accepted content

realtimeScribe.title: Realtime Voice Scribe
realtimeScribe.text: Realtime speech support that structures documentation while the consultation is happening.
points: History, symptoms, examination, assessment, and plan detection

visionRegistration.title: Vision for Patient Registration
visionRegistration.text: Registration intelligence for cleaner patient records and lower manual data entry at the front door of care.
points: Extract details from forms, IDs, or documents
Attach source documents to the patient record

visionDocumentation.title: Vision for Documentation
visionDocumentation.text: Document understanding for scanned reports, prescriptions, referral letters, lab reports, and historical notes.
points: Convert paper records into structured data

recordSummary.title: AI Summary on Records
recordSummary.text: Patient summaries that help care teams reach the right part of a long record faster.

doctorSummary.title: Doctor Summary
doctorSummary.text: A concise view of the patient before the consultation begins, designed to reduce cognitive load.

careAsk.title: Care Ask
careAsk.text: A doctor-facing copilot for patient-context questions and workflow support across the CARE record.
points: What changed since the last visit?
Generate patient instructions from today’s plan

differentialDiagnosis.title: Differential Diagnosis Support
differentialDiagnosis.text: Careful, clinician-led reasoning support for structured checklists, red flags, and missing history prompts.
points: Consider, ask, check, and rule out suggestions

carePlan.title: Care Plan Generation
carePlan.text: Draft care plans that can become tasks, reminders, referrals, follow-ups, and measurable continuity.

scoreCalculators.title: AI-Powered Score Calculators
scoreCalculators.text: Score calculators connected to structured data and the escalation workflows that follow.

drugSafety.title: Drug Safety Alerts
drugSafety.text: Relevant, explainable, severity-ranked prescribing alerts where medication decisions happen.
points: Renal, hepatic, pregnancy, and age cautions

dischargeSummary.title: Discharge Summary Builder
dischargeSummary.text: Draft discharge summaries generated from the actual hospital timeline, then reviewed and signed.

handoverChart.title: Handover Chart
handoverChart.text: Structured handover notes for shifts, wards, teams, and high-risk transitions of care.

formBuilder.title: Care Form Builder Skill
formBuilder.text: AI support for converting guidelines, PDFs, SOPs, and paper forms into draft CARE forms and workflows.

formEnhancer.title: Care Form Enhancer
formEnhancer.text: Submission analysis that suggests how program forms can become clearer, faster, and more structured.
points: Long completion time and drop-off points
Free-text patterns that should become structured fields

teams.title: Different teams need different intelligence.
teams.body: CARE AI is designed for doctors, nurses, field workers, hospitals, public-health programs, and implementation partners who need AI that is practical, responsible, and grounded in real health-system data.

doctors.title: For doctors
doctors.text: Spend less time searching and typing, and more time making decisions.

nurses.title: For nurses
nurses.text: Document faster, coordinate better, and reduce handover risk.

fieldWorkers.title: For field workers
fieldWorkers.text: Complete structured documentation with less typing and better local-language support.

hospitals.title: For hospitals
hospitals.text: Improve documentation quality, discharge workflows, patient handovers, and medication safety.

publicHealth.title: For public-health programs
publicHealth.text: Move from guidelines to better digital workflows and stronger program learning loops.

extensible.title: CARE can be the trusted substrate for partner AI.
extensible.body: Not every AI capability needs to be built by OHC Foundation. CARE should make it possible for trusted AI partners, research institutions, public-sector AI initiatives, and local model providers to integrate safely into healthcare workflows.

externalScribes.title: External scribe providers
externalScribes.text: CARE can support voice-to-discrete-data integrations where a partner scribe transforms doctor-patient conversations into structured notes while CARE remains the patient-context layer and system of record.

ekaScribe.title: Eka Scribe via V2DD-style integrations
ekaScribe.text: A scribe partner can provide structured voice outputs, while CARE provides workflow context, review surfaces, final save, and auditability.

indiaAi.title: India AI models and AI Centers of Excellence
indiaAi.text: As Indian foundational models, local-language models, and healthcare AI research mature, CARE can provide the real-world health-system layer for responsible evaluation and use.

researchModels.title: Research and government-approved AI models
researchModels.text: Trusted partners can bring speech, vision, drug-safety, score-calculation, summarization, and program-specific models through plugin patterns.

safety.title: Healthcare AI must be designed for trust.
safety.body: CARE AI follows a safety-first posture: source grounding, human review, role-based access, audit trails, clinical accountability, and real-world evaluation.

humanReview.title: Human review
humanReview.text: AI-generated clinical content should be reviewed before becoming part of the medical record.

sourceGrounding.title: Source grounding
sourceGrounding.text: Summaries, discharge notes, handovers, and care plans should link back to source records wherever possible.

roleBasedAccess.title: Role-based access
roleBasedAccess.text: A doctor, nurse, volunteer, administrator, and researcher should not have the same AI capabilities or data access.

auditTrails.title: Audit trails
auditTrails.text: Every AI interaction should log who used it, what context was used, what was generated, what was edited, and what was saved.

accountability.title: Clinical accountability
accountability.text: AI supports the care team. It does not replace clinical responsibility.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.text: Every AI feature should be measured by workflow impact, safety, adoption, quality, and outcomes.

roadmap.title: From documentation relief to learning health systems.

horizon1.title: Documentation relief
horizon1.text: Reduce typing and improve structured capture.

horizon3.title: Learning health systems
horizon3.text: Move from assistance to continuous improvement.

difference.title: A safer, faster interface to trusted healthcare infrastructure.
difference.body: The goal is not to make healthcare workers depend on another black-box product. The goal is to give them a smarter interface to open, accountable infrastructure.

standardsAligned.title: Standards-aligned
standardsAligned.text: Built on open healthcare data models.

extensible.title: Extensible
extensible.text: Ready for partner models and AI integrations.

publicGood.title: Public-good oriented
publicGood.text: Designed to strengthen open healthcare infrastructure.

whatIs.question: What is CARE AI?
whatIs.answer: CARE AI is the assistive intelligence layer built on top of CARE Core. It brings AI-powered documentation, summarization, voice workflows, form intelligence, clinical context, care planning, safety alerts, and workflow support into the same open healthcare platform where care is delivered.

aiDoctor.question: Is CARE AI an AI doctor?
aiDoctor.answer: No. CARE AI is not an AI doctor, autonomous diagnosis tool, or black-box product outside the clinical workflow. It drafts, extracts, summarizes, suggests, and calculates while humans review and decide.

principle.question: What is the CARE AI principle?
principle.answer: AI drafts. Humans decide. CARE records. Systems learn. CARE AI is built around human review, clinical accountability, source grounding, role-based permissions, and audit trails.

careScribe.question: What is Care Scribe?
careScribe.answer: Care Scribe helps doctors, nurses, and care teams convert speech and clinical conversations into structured documentation inside CARE. It is documentation assistance grounded in the patient record and active workflow.

chatbot.question: How is CARE AI different from a standalone chatbot?
chatbot.answer: CARE AI starts with the health system. It uses CARE Core context such as patients, encounters, forms, roles, orders, medications, labs, care plans, tasks, audit trails, APIs, and standards-based data models.

partners.question: Can external AI partners integrate with CARE AI?
partners.answer: Yes. CARE AI is designed as an open and extensible AI layer where trusted scribe providers, speech models, vision models, local-language models, drug-safety engines, score calculators, and research models can integrate safely into CARE workflows.

final.title: AI for the healthcare commons.
final.body: CARE Core gives AI the context. CARE AI gives health workers the interface. Human review keeps care accountable. Open infrastructure makes the model reusable.
final.tagline: CARE AI is responsible AI on trusted healthcare infrastructure.
